text:
emily-sales: FYI — we're rolling a small rate-card consolidation next week that affects the `legacy-reserved` and `slim` SKUs. Need quick alignment on grandfathering + POC concession rules.

raj-se: Can you paste the delta? Customers on POC now — do we auto-apply old pricing?

emily-sales: Short version:
- merge `slim` into `standard-flex`
- `legacy-reserved` tiers deprecated, replaced by `commit-v2`
- small price +2% on compute units for non-commit monthly
Grandfathering for active commits: full preservation until contract renewal
POC concessions: up to 25% one-time credit; >25% needs deal-desk approval.

priya-revops: Need exact lines for CPQ. Also we should add script to auto-tag affected quotes.

marcus-dealdesk: Marcus here — approved concession matrix: <=15% AE signoff, 15-25% RevOps signoff, >25% require Director Deal Desk + finance ok. Add case-by-case for strategic logos.

chloe-legal: Legal note: no change to T&Cs; add an addendum clause for "price variation" and grandfathering. I'll draft one.

nicholas-sales-engineering: For POCs, can we leave a short-term SKU mapping in the quote template? Suggest snippet:
```
if sku == 'slim': sku = 'standard-flex'
if sku == 'legacy-reserved': sku = 'commit-v2'  # map but keep legacy price if active_commit == true
```

emily-sales: @marcus @priya-revops please confirm approval flow & update CPQ by Tues EOD. I have three mid-market deals in flight that need quoting.

ratecard-bot: New rate card draft uploaded: https://redwood-internal/ratecards/rc-2026-03-consolidation (doc id 0x8a9). Review by Tue 18:00.

priya-revops: I'll add tags + create CPQ mapping change request. @emily-sales ping me PR numbers and the deal IDs.

emily-sales: Deal IDs: R-3456, R-3499, R-3501. Thanks everyone — let's not auto-apply to live contracts without ops/legal signoff. :thumbsup:

marcus-dealdesk: Noted. I'll post the official concession matrix in #deal-desk after ROI/ARR thresholds are clarified.

emily-sales: Closing with action items:
- @priya-revops: CPQ mapping + tags
- @marcus-dealdesk: formal concession matrix
- @chloe-legal: addendum draft
- @nicholas-sales-engineering: quote template snippet
Target: CPQ & docs updated by Tue EOD. Thanks!
